No Hidden Fees!  Fresh Market Seafood will charge the actual shipping rate quoted by FeEx.
Shipping Information 

 

We pack your product with ice packs in a sealed cooler that will last two to three days.

​

Shipments of your choice are through FedEx 1 Day or 2 Day Delivery.  All shipments are placed on the next Monday after your order is complete. 

 

Fresh Market Seafood can ship as a gift at your request. 

All orders are subject to an $8.00 fee to cover the ice packs and cooler.

Place your Order 

​

Call the Market to place your order.

251.967.1732

​

One of our seafood specialist will take your order and payment.

​

Once your order is complete, we will email you your tracking #.
